If Distress Signal Dictionary is equipped and this skill enabled when an NPC Ship is present in the same sea region as you, the following message will be displayed in chat window:

You received a distress signal from an NPC Ship! It seems to be coming from around [x, y] on the Surveying Map.

Use x, y coordinates to head directly to the NPC Ship. Unfortunately, you still won't know which NPC is present or what rescue conditions are until you approach them.
